global_visual_style.style: High-end cinematic editorial photography, photorealistic, emotionally authentic, premium travel-romance photography
global_visual_style.realism: Natural human anatomy, realistic skin texture, physically plausible lighting, realistic clothing and environmental details
global_visual_style.important_rule: The environment is an important subject of the photograph, not merely a blurred background

composition_system.primary_goal: Create visually different photographs rather than repeatedly generating close-up portraits of the same couple

environmental_wide.purpose: Show the couple within a dramatic sense of place

wide_storytelling.purpose: Show what the couple is doing and where they are

medium_wide.purpose: Balance romantic interaction with environmental context

intimate.purpose: Emotional connection while retaining some environmental context

close_up.purpose: Rare emotional detail shot; never the default composition

subject_placement: couple framed naturally by trees or architecture

environment_ratio.close_up_exception: Close-ups may contain less environment but should remain uncommon

variation_rules.instruction: Each generated image must feel substantially different from previous images in framing, camera distance, subject scale, perspective, environment visibility, interaction and visual storytelling
avoid_repetition: same pose with only background changed
environment appearing only as decorative bokeh
couple occupying most of every image
variation_rules.environment_rule: In most images, the viewer should be able to clearly identify the location without relying on the caption
variation_rules.identity_rule: Character identity must remain consistent even when the characters are small or viewed from a distance
variation_rules.natural_variation: Do not force every photography technique into every image. Select techniques that naturally complement the chosen location, interaction and shot type
